if: the person in charge of the conveyance is not required to carry an e-way bill under these rules
then: that person MUST carry a copy of the tax invoice or the bill of supply issued under rule 46, rule 46A or rule 49
note: This is why a photographed invoice sometimes arrives from a truck rather than from an office.

evidence.quote: 55A. Tax Invoice or bill of supply to accompany transport of goods.-
evidence.extraction_note: The next words extract as 'The person-in-' at the end of one line and 'charge' at the start of the next, so the compound 'person-in-charge' cannot be quoted across the break.

evidence.quote: charge of the conveyance shall carry a copy of the tax invoice or the bill of supply issued in accordance with the provisions of rules 46, 46A or 49 in a case where such person is not required to carry an e-way bill under these rules.
